description.value: Crown Palace is a Chinese restaurant in Victoria's Gorge-Burnside neighbourhood offering traditional Cantonese and Szechuan dishes, from ginger fried beef and chow mein to coconut curry and noodle boxes. The broad menu includes a full vegetarian section with tofu and vegetable-based mains, and the restaurant offers online ordering with delivery. It makes a solid meal stop for cyclists coming off the Galloping Goose or E&N rail trails nearby.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: safe_loops (3 spaces) at 11m; rack (8 spaces) at 47m; rack (2 spaces) at 80m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active restaurant at 405 Craigflower Rd, Victoria, BC V9A 2V7 with phone +1 250 383-5322; customer reviews dated up to May 2026 and a published business hours page confirm the business is currently operating. The menu features a dedicated 'Vegetarian Dishes' section with eight items and a legend marking individual vegetarian items, confirming that amenity; the site's online ordering system and customer review references to delivery confirm takeout service. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
